page_title: AI Tools for Video, Images & Editing | neural.love

sources.entry: Neural Love - AI for video restoration and enhancement.

summary.name: neural.love
summary.one_liner: neural.love is a browser-based AI platform for enhancing and restoring videos and images, generating images, editing images through text descriptions, and animating photos into video.
use_cases: edit images by typing a description
turn a still photo into an animated MP4
generate professional headshots or LinkedIn photos from one picture
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser-based service (no installation) for colorizing, smoothing and enhancing videos, with claims of restoring digital media from any era. Users can upload images to resize, enhance, or restore them, and edit images by describing the change (e.g., replacing objects, turning night into day, removing JPEG artifacts). It offers image generation with multiple AI models and transforms static images into MP4 videos. A photo studio creates headshot, Instagram, and LinkedIn-style images from a single photo without model training. The site uses a credit system shared across its AI tools, with buy-credit or subscription options.
notable: Single credit balance across all AI tools
Creative Upscale lets users control AI hallucinations during image enhancement
Text-described image edits such as camera moves and object replacement
Photo studio generates headshots and LinkedIn photos from one photo with no training
caveats: Uses a credit system; buying credits or subscribing is needed for usage beyond the free sign-up (page says 'Start Small: Buy Credits or Subscribe')
Page lists user and usage counts and reviews as marketing; no pricing figures are given on the page
